description: This file defines classes and functions related to file system operations, including file handling, directory management, and partition information within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, and provides interfaces for file creation, opening, reading, writing, and directory traversal.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, and managing file attributes across different platforms.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Provides directory traversal, creation, deletion, and management functionalities, supporting both Linux and Windows platforms.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Encapsulates information about disk partitions, including size, free space, and mount points.

methods.name: ParsePathInfo
methods.description: Parses a string containing path information and permissions, extracting the path and permission bits.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a full path.

methods.name: FileNameExtended
methods.description: Returns the filename with extension from a full path.

methods.name: PathName
methods.description: Returns the directory path from a full filename.

methods.name: IsPathAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if a given path is absolute.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension from a filename.
